title: Specific Targets for Singapore's Global Share of Aggregate Computing Power
what_it_is: Specific Targets for Singapore's Global Share of Aggregate Computing Power

sections.label: Computing resources and digital connectivity
sections.summary: The Government refers to its digital connectivity blueprint and published documents on sustainable data centres, industry digitalisation, training and AI computing needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications)
sentences.text: The amount of computing resources needed in Singapore will depend on the workloads that the private and public sectors expect to process and how these workloads are distributed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications)
sentences.text: This will change dynamically in response to needs and available alternatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If so, how would the Government ensure that Singaporeans directly benefit from these developments and we create a more level paying field for everyone to access such computing power, including microenterprises, students and individual Singaporeans?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would refer the Member to our digital connectivity blueprint as well as documents associated with how we have called for more applications for data centres which conform to sustainability measures – in answer to his second question.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: These have been published, where we are pushing for the data centres that are located in Singapore to be more environmentally friendly, to be more sustainable in terms of the energy used for computing, the software that runs on them, as well as how they maintain their facilities, the cooling standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Well, again, I would refer to the various documents that we published, looking at how we are digitalising a variety of industries and this digitalisation of the industries should, through these strategies, result in better jobs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are also trying to make sure that Singaporeans have the training and skills necessary to take advantage of these opportunities that are brought here.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: But given the stated goal of the Government in its national AI strategy to push for applications within the Government, I wonder if there are at least plans to consider ramping up, especially graphical processing units acquisition, because this is so critical to ensuring foundational AI model development, including that by the Government sector.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would refer the Member to the digital connectivity blueprint which stated exactly that.
